page.content:
Fenced park no citizen may enter, see, or discuss, full of hooded figures.

How the dog park connects

  • Location: Night Vale — The forbidden dog park sits inside Night Vale.
  • Character: Intern Dana — Dana is lost in the dog park and comes back changed.

What is the dog park?

The dog park is the forbidden enclosure at the edge of Night Vale: no dogs, no citizens, hooded figures, and a hole Intern Dana falls through into another version of the town.

Key threads lead to Night Vale and Intern Dana.
